verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile's official docs explicitly support reviewing, commenting, approving and merging PRs from the phone, plus Copilot-assisted code review, which directly matches the story. However, multiple hands-on community reports describe genuine friction in the review experience itself (diff line-wrapping, large font making diffs hard to read, diff view called 'unusable') and missing PR-review notifications, undercutting a purely full delivery. Missing for 10: independent confirmation that diff readability issues have been fixed, and consistent positive reviews of the core review UX rather than mixed reports.
